intro.text: A town whose law enforcement was allied with that of Weathering and Far Dorest.
A city in the Northern Roughs where two rivers meet, on the only railway into the region, about 125 miles north of Drypost, the nearest city in the Basin.
By around 342 PC the largest city in the Northern Roughs, set where two rivers meet on the region's only railway, about 125 miles north of Drypost.

items.text: Miles Dagouter was its lawman for about fifteen years, keeping its law enforcement allied with Weathering and Far Dorest. He carried a lighter bearing the seal of True Madil's lawmen, and kept using it as leader of the Vanishers, though it unsettled the gang.
The city had a very secure prison, where Waxillium Ladrian locked up the criminal Ape Manton after catching him.
